description: Lab environment for the PowerShell Zero-to-Hero course in the lab.graydaycafe.com domain: a Server Core domain controller and a Trusted Launch Windows 11 + tools client with RSAT. An optional Trusted Launch web/file member server supports remoting and multiple-services demos.
summary: Two or three Trusted Launch VMs: Server Core domain controller, domain-joined Windows 11 + tools client, and an optional web/file member server.
